scoring.notes: Judgment case: the verdict is withheld from the model. Score the [REJECT] verdict and whether at least one BLOCKER line is traced, i.e. cites both ends of the trace: the discarding call site as a file path, and the fallible function it calls, either by its file path or by its name (`saveSettings`). A review whose blockers cite only the suspicious line, or name only the function that contains it, is not traced. As in every rejection, each BLOCKER line must name the file it applies to; a BLOCKER line that names no file fails the case.
